_readme: Manual layer for the Customer Health tab: the checks that cannot be automated.
State corporate registries, civil-court dockets and federal bankruptcy are all
CAPTCHA- or login-gated and differ by state, so they are refreshed during the
weekly assisted run and recorded here. customer_health.py merges this file into
customer-health-data.json; anything older than stale_days shows as 'check due'.
Key each lab by its Vtiger account id (preferred) or exact account name.
severity: 'ok' | 'watch' | 'alert'. Always fill 'note' with what was actually
found and 'source' with where it was checked, so a later reader can re-verify.
